en: Vintage postcard with a monochrome, blue-tinted studio portrait of a young noblewoman seated on an ornate throne-like chair with a leopard-skin drape. She wears a tiara and long pearl strands. Large white lilies are arranged beside her and an equestrian knight statue stands on a pedestal in the background. The reverse shows a divided back with multilingual 'Postkarte – Carte postale – Postcard' headings and address lines.
